tagline.en_US: Self-hosted document management for storing, organizing, searching, and sharing personal documents.

description.en_US: Papra is a minimalistic document management and archiving platform designed for long-term document storage. It enables users to upload, organize, and retrieve files like receipts and warranties through full-text search and automated content extraction. Features include automatic ingestion via email or folders, customizable tagging rules, organization management, and secure document sharing.
